messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(3 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The consolidation into lov_io_mirror_init() looks right apart from the read-past-EOF case, which needs a refresh. The new -EINVAL for buffered parity I/O has no test: lustre/tests/io_scope.c always opens with O_DIRECT, so nothing reaches it. Should sanity-ec add a case for that, and one for a STRIPE-scope pread() that runs past the parity EOF on a mixed-p mirror (the test_34d layout)?

commit.subject: LU-20690 lov: check designated stripe in mirror init
commit.message:
LU-20690 lov: check designated stripe in mirror init

Designated-stripe validation for RAID10-like EC parity was
repeated in lov_io_iter_init(), lov_io_lru_reserve() and
lov_lock_sub_init(), and rejected CIT_FAULT wholesale.

Check covered components once in lov_io_mirror_init().
Reject buffered designated parity I/O in lov_page_init_composite()
because the page cache is shared with data.

Test-Parameters: testlist=sanity-ec ostcount=8
